name: 94555 · Fremont, CA
findings: ZIP 94555 (Fremont) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94555 (Fremont) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 94555 (Fremont) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 35% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
